name: Crippling Shot (Ex)
body:
Prerequisites: Rogue or Ninja 4, Opportunities Aplenty class feature

Benefit(s): A number of times per day equal to half your rogue/ninja class level, you may activate this ability as a free action when you deal damage using your opportunities aplenty ability. If you do so, your opponent must make a successful Fort saving throw (DC 10 +1/2 your rogue/ninja class level + your Dexterity modifier) or suffer the staggered condition for 1 round per rogue/ninja class level you possess. If an opponent successfully saves against this talent, he is immune to your crippling shot for 24 hours.
